Dot & Key launches Dragon Fruit Bounce Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++ with UVA & UBA in-vivo testing
News provided by
Dot & Key
27 Mar, 2026, 09:30 IST
Share this article
Share to X
Share this article
KOLKATA, India , March 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Dot & Key, India's leading science-backed skincare brand announces the launch of its most anticipated skincare innovations, the Dragon Fruit Bounce Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++ , a next–generation formula that marks a significant leap forward in India's sunscreen landscape.
At a time when consumers increasingly look beyond basic SPF numbers and demand credible, clinically validated protection, Dot & Key introduces the only sunscreen in the category that is both UVA and UVB in – vivo tested , powered by new – age UV filters , enriched with antioxidant – rich dragon fruit , and strengthened by the brand's proprietary
Bounce – Lock™ Complex for hydrated, resilient, bouncy skin even during sun exposure suitable for oily and combination skin.
Continue Reading
Dot & Key Dragon Fruit Bounce Sunscreen
Powered by New-Age UV Filters this in-vivo tested, and certified Dot & Key Dragon Fruit Bounce Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++ has broad-spectrum UVA & UVB protection featuring a photostable formula that remains effective under prolonged sun exposure without degrading thereby providing long-lasting performance.
At the core of the innovation also lies Dot & Key's Bounce–Lock™ Support, a next–gen skin resilience technology powered by Ectoin and Niacinamide. This complex helps maintain hydration, strengthen the skin barrier, enhance tone uniformity, and promote a firmer, more even–looking complexion even under UV stress.
The new Dot & Key Dragon Fruit Bounce Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++ also addresses the common pain point of heavy, greasy sunscreens by introducing a lightweight Cushion-Gel texture that is breathable and fast absorbing, leaving behind no white cast or greasy residue, making it perfect for oily and combination skin.
Speaking on the launch, Suyash Saraf, Co – Founder of Dot & Key, said , "At Dot & Key, we've always believed that sunscreen deserves more science.
The Dragon Fruit Bounce Sunscreen stands as a culmination of Dot & Key's commitment to bringing the most advanced skincare technologies to India, offering consumers a product that protects, nourishes, and restores in one step.
With clinically validated efficacy, cutting-edge formulation science, and a sensorial profile crafted for Indian weather, the launch signals the brand's continued focus on raising the bar for everyday skincare.
Key features
* New-Age UV Filters
* Bounce-Lock™ Complex
* UVA and UVB in–vivo tested
* Infused with Antioxidant-Rich Dragon Fruit
* SPF 50+ PA++++ Broad-Spectrum Defense
* Photostable Formula
* Lightweight, Cushion-Gel Texture
* No White Cast
Available across all leading retailers Price: INR 445

Wilmington-based Green Dot Growing HVAC Business Throughout The Carolinas
By Christina Haley O'Neal, posted Jul 29, 2021
Tweet
Green Dot Heating & Air is expanding beyond its two locations in Wilmington (one shown above). (Photo courtesy of Green Dot)
Wilmington-headquartered Green Dot Heating & Air is undergoing a rapid expansion with new locations outside of the area.
The HVAC services company has recently closed on a seventh acquisition to expand from its Wilmington base, which has two locations: its headquarters at 3303 Merchant Court and a second space for its installation and sales departments at 204 Antilles Court in Dutch Square.
The business started in early 2020 by partners that include Chris Jones, CEO; Greg Nelson, president; and Wesley Tyler, COO. The group developed at the time a rollout strategy to begin acquiring heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) companies across the Carolinas to roll into a single brand, Jones said.
​“It’s an opportunity to buy very good businesses that didn’t really have an exit plan until we arrived. And we are buying the smaller companies,” Jones said.
Jones said another goal is to develop a business model that provides opportunities and a stable career path in the industry.
The firm has 75 full-time employees in North Carolina and South Carolina, with 32 of those workers in the Wilmington area.
I don’t think the trades have necessarily been given the credit for all the wonderful things they do for every one of our communities," he said. "I think the trades have been looked down upon."
Salary ranges in the HVAC industry, such as for a skilled service technician, can range between $50,000 and close to $100,000 a year, he said.
“It’s a highly skilled trade … there is such an opportunity for people who have a gift with their hands and gift with understanding electronics and refrigeration and airflow," Jones said. "If your mind works that way, you can create a wonderful life for yourself and a wonderful career.”
The COVID-19 pandemic has sparked more business and job opportunities in the HVAC industry, Jones said.
The company mainly focuses on HVAC residential systems, while also doing some light commercial business, he said.
Green Dot has opened other locations in the Seabrook/Kiawah area, Charleston, Columbia and Mount Pleasant in South Carolina.
“We are actively looking at additional acquisitions," Jones said. “We think we can get to $100 million in revenue on an annualized basis by the end of 2025.”
The business is moving at a fast pace with its acquisitions and is looking to triple the size of the company by late 2022.
“We just really are trying to create something special.
Something unique in this industry. Something that for the most part really doesn't exist in the marketplace, which is a large residential-focused, singular-branded company across North and South Carolina,” Jones said. “We want to be the biggest in the state.”

* IR
* IR

Nykaa-owned skincare brand Dot & Key has reported GMV of Rs 1,790 crore in FY26, registering a 13X increase over the past three years. The growth comes as digitally native beauty and skincare brands continue to expand their presence across India's online and offline retail channels.
Founded in Kolkata by Suyash Saraf and Anisha Saraf, Dot & Key has expanded its skincare portfolio while building distribution across marketplaces, quick commerce platforms and Nykaa's omnichannel network.
Dot & Key currently ranks #1 in the sunscreen category, #2 in moisturizers and #3 in face wash across marketplaces and quick commerce platforms.
Its portfolio covers multiple skincare categories, including sunscreens, moisturizers, face washes and other products.
The company's expansion has also increased its role within Nykaa's portfolio of owned brands.
Dot & Key, alongside Kay Beauty, has emerged as one of the brands contributing to Nykaa's beauty business as the company builds its presence across different consumer segments.
Nykaa strengthened its investment in Dot & Key in 2024 by increasing its ownership in the skincare company from 51 percent to 90 percent.
The transaction was reportedly valued at Rs 265.3 crore.
Dot & Key's FY26 performance comes amid broader changes in India's beauty and personal care industry. Digitally native brands are increasingly using marketplaces, quick commerce and offline retail to expand beyond their original direct-to-consumer models.
Consumer demand for specialised skincare products has also encouraged Indian beauty companies to broaden their portfolios and strengthen distribution. For Dot & Key, its integration with Nykaa and expansion across multiple commerce channels have supported its growth over the past three years.
With revenue reaching Rs 1,790 crore in FY26 and the company reporting a 13X increase over three years, Dot & Key has expanded its scale within India's D2C beauty and skincare market.

A peek into how Dot & Key reached relevant audiences
Founded in 2018, Dot & Key is a young brand that provides skincare solutions through products such as sunscreen, moisturizer, face serums, face wash, lip balms, with a focus on serving Gen Z adults and millennial women located in Metro and Tier 1 cities in India.
Amazon MX Player
When Dot & Key wanted to reach their core audience through video streaming channels, they decided to leverage Amazon MX Player (erstwhile miniTV), a video ad solution that operates in India, offering a wide range of commissioned content across diverse genres relevant to young adults.
Amazon MX Player
Specifically, Dot & Key recognized that using Amazon MX Player could help them build relevant reach, as 2 in every 3 Amazon MX Player streamers shop for personal care or beauty products, 1 and approximately 80% of MX Player users are between ages 18 and 34. 2
Amazon MX Player
Dot & Key and Amazon Ads worked together to devise a 360-degree marketing plan comprising show sponsorships, brand integrations, and in-stream video advertising.
Amazon MX Player
From July 2023 to February 2024, Dot & Key promoted their sunscreen and moisturizer product ranges through top MX Player shows across different genres, including romance and relationships, drama, and comedy, while also serving as sponsors for the shows Badi Heroine Banti Hai and Jamnapaar.
Amazon MX Player
The brand gained further visibility by sponsoring online and offline promotions for the shows, as well as by using contextual content integrations within episodes.
Amazon MX Player
Dot & Key also employed co-branded social media promotions and brand videos along with display ads on the Amazon.in homepage and in-stream video ads in MX Player shows to help drive reach and engagement.
Amazon MX Player
Radiant results and improved metrics
Amazon MX Player
Over the course of eight months, the campaign delivered more than 84 million video ad impressions across MX Player shows, 3 with average click-through rates of 1.8% 4 and video completion rates of 95%.
Amazon MX Player
6 In addition, brand recall (as measured by the number of branded searches on Amazon.in) grew by 65%, 7 and the brand’s share of detail page views in the moisturizer and sunscreen categories saw a jump of 100% on Amazon.in. 8
Amazon MX Player
Working with Amazon Ads has helped us reach relevant young adult audiences through commissioned and differentiated content on MX Player shows, across a variety of touchpoints—with a measurable impact on both mind measures and mid-funnel metrics."
Suyash Saraf , Co-founder - Dot & Key

Dot & Key Introduces India’s First 15-Shade Tinted Sunscreen
Lifestyle
Published By - Nirali Sethi
August 25, 2026
Reading time - 2 min.
Facebook X Copy URL [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=Dot+%26+Key+Introduces+India%E2%80%99s+First+15-Shade+Tinted+Sunscreen %0A%0A https://thecsrjournal.in/dot-key-introduces-indias-first-15-shade-tinted-sunscreen "WhatsApp")
The CSR Journal Magazine
Indian skincare brand Dot & Key has launched its new Strawberry Dew Tinted Sunscreen range, featuring 15 shades designed to cater to a wide variety of Indian skin tones. The launch positions the brand as the first Indian skincare company to introduce a tinted sunscreen range with such an extensive shade selection.
Broad-Spectrum Sun Protection
The new formulation uses modern UV filters to provide broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays, while also offering protection against blue light exposure. The lightweight, fast-absorbing formula is designed to leave a dewy finish without creating a white cast.
Skincare Benefits With Buildable Coverage
The tinted sunscreen provides buildable coverage intended to even out skin tone while combining sun protection with skincare benefits. Ingredients including hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and panthenol are included to support hydration and the skin barrier.
Designed for Indian Skin Tones
The range includes shades across lighter, medium, and richer skin tones. Examples include Peony and Porcelain for lighter tones, Sand and Honey for medium tones, and Caramel and Hazelnut for richer complexions.
Addressing a Gap in the Market
Anisha Agarwal Saraf, Co-Founder and Chief Innovation Officer of Dot & Key Skincare, said the product aims to address a gap faced by Indian consumers who often have to choose between effective sun protection, suitable shades, and skincare benefits.
The range combines these features into one product, with the goal of simplifying daily skincare routines.
Distinctive Heart-Shaped Packaging
The Strawberry Dew Tinted Sunscreen comes in a distinctive heart-shaped tube, designed to make the product more appealing and enhance the application experience.
Available Across India
The new sunscreen range is available through Dot & Key’s official website, e-commerce platforms, and retail outlets across India.
About Dot & Key
Founded in 2018 by Anisha Agarwal Saraf and Suyash Saraf, Dot & Key is headquartered in Kolkata and focuses on consumer-oriented skincare products. Its portfolio includes sunscreens, moisturizers, face washes, and other skincare products.
The brand develops its formulations in-house with support from skincare scientists and is backed by Nykaa, a major beauty and wellness company in India.
